reviews.text: I brought my cat here based on a recommendation, but unfortunately he was unable to be groomed due to his behavior. I completely understood their suggestion to speak with his vet about medication to help him relax. However, when I picked him up, he had poop all over his bottom and no one mentioned it to me. This was very disappointing and felt like poor communication, especially because it was clearly noticeable. I understand that they could not groom him, but I expected to at least be informed about his condition before leaving.
Nice cat grooming, boarding and toys and food supply boutique. Nice staff and you can visit adoptable cats in a nice room by the front door.

Ordered 4 collars 27/7, supposedly dispatched 28/7, last tracking update 29/7 but still in Dallas. No updates since, business dismissive of my concerns stating no update until items reach the UK!  The order must be crossing the Atlantic by canoe!  Seems to be take your money then middle finger to all queries!!

I took my sweet boy to Cat Connections for grooming recently. I haven’t taken him anywhere for grooming in a long time, I wasn’t sure how he would react. They did an amazing job!! I am so happy with the results and he was able to handle it well. Priscilla was so sweet and caring with him. I would recommend them to anyone looking for cat specific services, and ask for Priscilla! We will be regular customers now 🩵

Took our sweet boy to get groomed for the first time and our experience was exceptional from start to finish. Everyone was so sweet and kind and explained the types of grooming that would benefit him the most and the process they have in place. When I picked him up he seemed calm and not stressed at all. 10/10 experience
We saw a post on IG talking great things about the place. We brought our car and were not allowed to walk him inside. Then there was nothing else to do. Disappointing

Wonderful service by cat connection for our two british shorthair male cats with basic service plus tummy shave, all for a reasonable price. The cats good thru this summer and till next summer, as their thick coat at tummy is now gone. Lindsay was really good with her grooming work and made a good effect on the cats. The cats are much happier now. Highly recommend this place if you hold your cats dear and near to yourself.

Best cat haircuts. My ladies usually squirm and I was nervous they’d need sedation but the folks at cat connection did a beautiful job on my two cats with just the regular level of  oral medication to calm them. So happy to have found this wonderful cat groomer.

Unfortunately, my experience was very poor. I was told a same length cut was possible for my cat, but when I picked him up the cut was very choppy and not what I requested/was told to expect.
The groomer then said a same-length cut was impossible, which I wish had been communicated upfront or via a call, as I had requested.

After discussing how to fix it, they initially wanted to charge me full price ($138) for a second cut, which felt like poor customer service given the issue stemmed from their miscommunication on their part. They eventually agreed to have me pay only the price difference ($23.81), which felt fair.

While the final result looked much better, the customer service on both days was rude and made me feel like an inconvenience. Because of this, I would not recommend or return.

Pic below of the first hair cut. The second appointment cut turned out okay with a lion cut.

An invaluable "Connection" for our two very young kittens. Not only for food and toys. They groom and board. Our litter mates are a little skittisk about nail clipping. It was really helpful that we could go to Cat Connection for about half the price of our veterinarian.
Owner is super knowledgeable and gives great advice!!

I have regularly brought my cats here for grooming and they come out so clean and well groomed. I have boarded my kitties here as well and they were well cared for. It is so hard to find a place like this, if you’re looking for grooming or boarding, I highly recommend!

Our sweet cat was very matted due to his long hair. And I couldn’t find anyone to groom him. I stumbled across Cat Connection and I will never go anywhere else.  The place is immaculate!   Very cool retail boutique to shop in for your cat!   The staff was so kind, very knowledgeable and absolutely FANTASTIC!!!   Our cat had to be almost completely shaved because his long hair had gotten so bad and he wasn’t a big fan!  But they pushed through and he left looking so good.   I highly recommend this place and I am not one to normally take the time to do a review!  But this place deserves all of the gold stars!     Graham the cat will be back and hopefully he can be nicer next time 🤣.   Thanks Cat Connection  for doing such an outstanding job.

This place always takes great care of my boy when I'm out of town and I need a place for boarding. They make sure to do a mini physical before boarding to make sure he doesn't have fleas, which tells me they really care about every cat they take in. I really appreciate the fact that they're cat focused and the employees all seem to be understanding and eager to take care of my baby.

I love this place. They do such a wonderful job on my Himalayan. She gets a Nala cut for summer. I always listen to their suggestions about the cut, especially since my fur baby is elderly and on medication. They are all very professional and friendly. Absolutely recommend.

holy smokes! absolutely blown away with how incredible my 12 year old long haired Bombay looks. Desiree did a phenomenal detailing on Bentley and I can't say enough wonderful things about Angela and the team.
Highly recommend! It's hard now a days to find grooming services for cats and cat connection is our #1 place! Great service and very communicative.

This place used to be SO GREAT! I literally loved taking my kitty here, but ever since they changed locations down the street, the management is poor, service is poor, overall attitude is poor. Sad to have seen their downgrade
Literally the best cat groomers in the biz. And the store has the absolute best selection of cat everything. Cards, strollers, toys, bowls, all of it. Love this place.

I loved this place!!! My cat boarded here for three days and got grooming done here! I love that the cats get an area to run and play, helps them relieve some stress out from staying overnight. I received my cat happy and clean!

Very nice ,safe  job trimming my cats' nails. Always in and out.. Beautiful store only 7 blocks from home!  Have  been there several times  Totally
recommend!

Had a miscommunication about what services were going to be rendered, specifically about fleas and bathing. I requested no bathing, and was told my cat wouldn't receive a bath. I told the person doing the intake my cat had fleas, and she reiterated there wouln't be a bath per my request. (Vet said don't bathe her for 3 days because of flea medication. Picked her up at the end of the 3rd day. Turns out it was fine, I was just told incorrectly by the vet)

After picking her up, I learned she had been bathed against my instructions (it's their policy to give baths when fleas are present. Makes sense).

This is where the 5 star rating comes in. My cat is difficult to groom, especially bathe and trim her nails. More importantly, the way the staff responded to my frustrations (especially coming from a place where you know the customer is wrong) is what earned my admiration. They also recommended solutions to inadequate sedation, better veterinary care, etc. while having to deal with me voicing my frustrations (I was wrong, but didn't know it at the time). Also, the price for keeping my cat overnight and grooming her was pretty reasonable. I would recommend them to other cat owners.
